answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a refundable bond paired with delayed, reputation-weighted access. Every new agent locks collateral and completes independently sampled tasks for unrelated reviewers; a haven of honest attestations grows its privileges, while copied work or collusion burns the bond. A velvet reputation rises only after repeated clean epochs, and a tundra of low privileges limits fresh accounts. Creating many identities therefore multiplies cost, waiting time, and audit exposure instead of voting power.
